thread:
emma: Hi team, ACME onprem deployment seeing SSE stream cutoffs ~12s into responses. Customer reports duplicated tokens after client reconnect and a billing spike. They are on Dedicated Private behind their onprem gateway + corporate proxy.

raj: Thanks, can you paste the exact curl you used to repro?

emma: Customer sent this: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://inference.acme.corp/api/v1/stream?model=redwood-7b"```

mike: Quick note — their gateway MTU is 1400 and proxy does TLS-inspect + rate limiting. That could cause fragments and proxy-level timeouts.

emma: Repro steps from customer: 1) start a long-generation (2000 tokens) 2) stream SSE 3) after ~12s connection drops, client reconnects using resume token but sees duplicate partial chunk and duplicate billing for those tokens. They captured logs.

ingest-bot: received event: stream_disconnect client_ip=10.10.5.20 duration_ms=12104 reason=RST

raj: Can you drop the ingress logs and a chunk of the app logs showing resume token exchange? Also need the exact client header sequence.

emma: Paste from their proxy (sanitized): ```[2026-02-28T14:12:11Z] TLS_INSPECT: reassembled 3 fragments; [14:12:23] connection reset by peer; [14:12:23] proxy-retry-limit hit```

sophie: Two hypotheses: 1) MTU/fragmentation causing mid-SSE packet loss that the proxy treats as a hard reset 2) proxy rate limiter sees resumed request as a new request (no resume id preserved) and issues 429 -> client backoff + duplicate accounting.

mike: Also possible the resume token TTL expired and the backend accepted the new request but with replayed tokens duplication. Need to confirm resume-token validation logs.

emma: Customer attached curl + tcpdump excerpt: ```12:12:11.123 IP client > gateway: Flags [P.], seq 12345:12560, ack 54321 win 64240; 12:12:23.987 IP gateway > client: RST, seq 1, ack 1```

raj: Can we reproduce in staging by putting a proxy that does TLS-inspect + MTU 1400 and a rate limiter that forcibly resets connections after 12s? Sophie, can you spin up a test env?

sophie: I'll provision a staging ingress with MTU 1400 and a mitm proxy (tls-inspect) and run a continuous SSE generator. Also add a fake rate-limiter that returns `HTTP/1.1 429` if requests > 50/min per ip.

mike: For immediate mitigation for customer: ask them to enable client-side heartbeats (send `:heartbeat

` every 8s) and set `Connection: keep-alive` + `X-Redwood-Session-Resume: <token>` on reconnect. Heartbeats keep proxy state alive and reduce proxy idle timeouts.

emma: Customer tried heartbeat but proxy still resets; they said only increasing chunk size to smaller payloads helped (weird).

raj: That suggests fragmentation boundary crossing. If TLS-inspect reassembles incorrectly and then hits a buffer limit, the proxy could reset. We should check our SSE chunk boundary behavior: do we ever send very large frames without flush?

sophie: Runtime note: our streaming runtime flushes on newline or every 1KB. If client-level MTU < 1500 and TLS-inspect changes framing, we could end up with a chunk that proxies deem suspicious. I will instrument flush frequency and add a knob to force smaller flushes.

mike: Engineering action items: Sophie to add flush-size toggle + test. Raj to run staged repro with proxy and MTU. Emma to collect full pcap and exact headers from customer. I'll prepare a temporary billing credit if duplicates are confirmed.

emma: Customer asked if disabling TLS-inspect helps — they can test but it's corporate policy.

raj: Long-term fix: 1) make resume tokens idempotent server-side (guard duplicates) 2) detect resumed partials and de-dup token billing 3) expose `stream_chunk_size` config in Dedicated/Private to avoid large boundaries.

sophie: I'll open an RFC for chunking behavior and idempotent resume semantics. Mike, can you scope billing de-dupe with finance?

mike: On it, will coordinate with billing. If we confirm duplicate charge windows, we'll issue a targeted credit.

emma: Customer will run tcpdump and upload pcap to secure share. Thanks team.

raj: Thx. If anyone hits the repro earlier, ping `#eng-oncall`. I'm going to tail the staging ingress logs once Sophie spins it up. :eyes:

sophie: staging infra created: `staging-proxy-2230`, running tests now. I'll paste results in here when ready.

ingest-bot: test-run complete: stream_length=2000 tokens, disconnect_count=1, resume_success=true, duplicate_tokens=8

emma: Looks like we reproduced — duplicates small (8 tokens) but billing counts them. Customer relief will be big if we avoid charges.

mike: Next steps: block on RFC + billing de-dupe + staging validation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
